codeReview.summary: The FIX-001 implementation correctly addresses the NULL current->mem vulnerability (exec window bug) identified in DIAG-002. The fix sets current->mm and current->mem to NULL BEFORE calling mm_release(), preventing dangling pointers during the window between release and task_set_mm. This is a minimal, targeted fix that follows the recommended approach from the exec window analysis.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The fix follows the coding conventions from AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md - minimal targeted fix with proper comments explaining the vulnerability.

summary: FIX-001 successfully implements the fix for the NULL current->mem vulnerability. The fix correctly sets current->mm and current->mem to NULL before calling mm_release(), eliminating the exec window where dangling pointers could exist. All 119 tests pass, confirming no regressions. The fix is minimal (13 insertions, 3 deletions), well-documented with explanatory comments, and follows the recommended approach from DIAG-002 analysis.
